text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The dance party has begun,
and Kaori's performance is resounding through the venue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダンスパーティ本番。
会場にはカオリの演奏が響いていた。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
What a romantic performance...
It's entirely different from what she played this afternoon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何てロマンチックな演奏なのかしら……
昼間とは全然違うわ……！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
Say. Do you mind if I hold your hand?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
手を、
握っても
いいかい？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Not at all. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
もちろんよ……♪

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: I don't believe it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
本当に驚いたよ……！

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Her tranquil melody is setting the mood perfectly.
It's entirely different from before.
Just what in the world did you do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきとはまるで違う、
しっとりとしていてムーディな演奏。
一体、
何をしたのかな？

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. There's no need for words.
Her expression tells the entire story.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
皆まで語る必要はない。
彼女の顔を見れば分かるよ。

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she's about to wrap things up.
I should make myself scarce.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
そろそろ演奏が終わるようだ。
邪魔者は退散するとしよう。

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: Please tell her that her performance was exquisite.
text_block_list.orig_text:
素晴らしかったと、
彼女に伝えておいてくれたまえ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Haitai!
{0}! Sorry for the wait!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイターイ♪
{0}、お待たせさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: How was my performance?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の演奏、
どうだったー？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Great!
It's all thanks to your help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった～！
{0}が練習に付き合ってくれたからだね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Is that what the organizer said?
I'm glad my music was able to convince him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの人がそう言ってたの～？
ちゃんと音楽で納得させられたんだね～、
うれしいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That really did pay off. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり、
効果は抜群だったさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What did?
You helped me practice earlier, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
何の効果かって～？
さっき、
{0}と練習してたでしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That's when I realized.
Something felt different if I performed while staring at you. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
その時に気づいたんだけど、
{0}の顔をジ～っと見ながら演奏すると、
何だかいつもと違う演奏ができたんさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That's why I made sure to do the same during that performance just now. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからさっきも、
演奏しながら
{0}の顔をジ～っと見つめてたんだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha! You didn't even notice?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
気づかなかった～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it all went well thanks to that! ♪
The dance party was a big success, too! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげで演奏が上手くいってよかったさ～♪
ダンスパーティも成功したみたいで、
万々歳だね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hm... But, well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
でも～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it,
all I did today was perform.
text_block_list.orig_text:
思い出してみると～
今日は演奏しかしてないさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It was fun, but I'm feeling restless.
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しかったけど、
何だか体がウズウズするよねー？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
You feel it too, right?
A fiery passion welling up inside you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}もするよね～？
体が火照ってこない～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, come on!
Follow me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
というわけで{0}、
ちょっと付き合うさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
Can we borrow the stage for a bit?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの人ー！
ちょっとステージ借りるさー！

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: Of course. Use it as you please.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
自由に使ってくれたまえ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Woo! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
行っくよ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's time to dance!
text_block_list.orig_text: 一緒に踊るさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I can perform while dancing!
Like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
踊りながら弾けばいいさ～！
こんな感じで～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hiyasasa! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ひーやーさーさー♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Come on!
Show me some more passion! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
元気が足りないよ～！
もっと元気に元気に～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's great!
You're kind of off-beat, but I can tell you're giving it your all! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
いい感じだよ～！
リズムはズレてるけど、
一生懸命な気持ちは伝わってくるね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's sing as well!
Don't be shy! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら、
次は一緒に歌うさ～！
恥ずかしがっちゃダメさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's going on here?
I figured the party was over already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
何だ何だ？
パーティは終わったんじゃないのか？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
They look like they're having so much fun.
Do you mind if we join in, too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何て楽しそうなのかしら……
私たちも
参加していい？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Not at all! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: もちろんさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Dance when you want to dance!
Sing when you want to sing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
踊りたいときに踊って、
歌いたいときに歌えばいいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Feelings are in the music, and music's in the feelings!
text_block_list.orig_text: 音楽は気持ちだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You helped me understand the real meaning behind that today! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は{0}のおかげで、
それがよく分かったさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I still don't get why my heart starts racing
whenever I look at you, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも～、
{0}を見つめてると
胸の辺りがドキドキするのは、
何なのかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I wonder what these feelings are?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは、
何の気持ちなんだろうね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Oh well. I won't sweat it for now. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かんないけど、
なんくるないさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A lively rhythm resounded across the beach long into the night on that day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その日、海辺には楽しげなリズムが、
夜が更けるまで響き続けていたという。
